description: Checks real-time inventory and variant stock levels for products across the catalog. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'check_inventory' on Gear & Glam Store (gearandglam.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'search_products' or 'get_product_details' or 'calculate_order_total' for their respective operations). Parameters: handle (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

handle.description: Product handle or slug [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: check_inventory
title: Check Inventory
